sections.heading: Lore
sections.text:
"This pair of handcannons feels just right. Hmm... Noticed a few design OFIs. Guess I'll just mod them into a pair of Yvonne-specials!"
 Yvonne is an operator in the Specialist Tech Division of Endfield Industries, currently responsible for research on Æther, Blight and related devices.
 At first glance, Yvonne looks like your typical rebellious fashionista — painting her horns, tail, and nails in eye-popping colors. She'll skip out on academic conferences just to snag the latest fashion magazines and pop albums. Drawn to all things new and unconventional, Yvonne has a knack for staying one step ahead of the trends, always marching to the beat of her own drum.
 But no one can deny that she is a true genius. Even back in her school days, she was racking up accolades in scientific research that others could only dream of. Everyone expected her to join a top-tier research institute and lead the charge in her field. Instead, Yvonne turned her back on it all and chose to join Endfield.
 The reason? She never explained it. Maybe you can ask her yourself.

sections.heading: Kit Intro
sections.text:
Yvonne is a 6-star, Cryo, Handcannon damage dealer, completely centered around building and consuming Cryo or Nature Infliction stacks with her Battle Skill in order to access her Ultimate, which is responsible for most of her damage.
 Similar to other hyper carries like Laevatain or Last Rite, Yvonne features an incredibly powerful but expensive Ultimate that can only be efficiently accessed by playing into her signature mechanic of Solidification. Yvonne’s core gameplay loop is building Nature or Cryo Infliction on enemies, then forcibly consuming them with her Battle Skill to generate energy based on the amount of the stacks, while also forcibly applying Solidification in the process. Doing this also immediately triggers her combo skill, which grants yet more energy and applies Solidification again after a short delay, which is a perfect segway into her Ultimate, which causes her to fire a stream of bullets over 7-8 seconds, followed by a Solidification-consuming final shot - when timed correctly, it will consume the Solidification applied by the combo.
 In well-structured teams, Yvonne’s rotations flow nicely, but there can be some pitfalls if you’re not careful. Yvonne can easily mix Nature and Cryo units and Inflictions, but wants to isolate their Infliction application to one type per Battle Skill to avoid Natural Arts reactions. Any reaction you trigger outside of Yvonne’s Battle Skill is wasted energy that Yvonne could have put toward her next Ultimate. Because of this, it’s important to manage when you’re using each character's abilities to ensure you only apply either Cryo or Nature at one time. An easy solution is to just play either Nature or Cryo, but doing so may limit you from playing the most powerful unit combinations.
 The other thing to consider when playing Yvonne is that her Ultimate requires a significant amount of in-game time to fully execute, something that is easier said than done against boss enemies immune to Solidification's controlling effect. Against these enemies, you’ll either need to wait for Stagger or time it perfectly, or else you’ll risk losing firing time and thus a lot of potential damage. Yvonne’s combo skill suffers a similar fate, being a deployable object that pulses damage over a short period, only to then explode. Throw it at the wrong time, or in the wrong position, and enemies can easily walk straight out of it, causing lost damage and, more importantly, a loss of potential Solidification application, which, when considering Yvonne’s Ultimate finishing effect, can also reduce potential damage a lot.
 All up, Yvonne is a quirky hyper-carry character who relies on Inflictions to function, but can’t apply them herself, instead relying on teammates and strong team building to enable her. She requires planning in and out of combat to be effective, but can deliver satisfying payoffs when everything lines up just right.

sections.heading: Passives
sections.text:
Before getting into the meat of Yvonne’s kit, it’s important to understand her passives, one of which is vital to her damage scaling and the other of which is a key part of her rotations.
 Her first talent, Freezing Point, grants her up to 20 Crit DMG% when attacking enemies with Cryo Infliction and double that (40%) when attacking Solidified enemies. Crit DMG% is an incredibly rare stat in Endfield, and having access to so much of it here and from her Ultimate makes Crit Rate one of Yvonne’s best stats. Yvonne will have Solidification up for most of her most impactful damage-dealing moments just by executing a standard rotation, but the fact that Cryo teams can maintain Cryo Infliction the rest of the time is one edge that Infliction type has over Nature-themed teams for Yvonne.
 Note: The bonus Crit DMG% from this talent applies to the damage dealt by Yvonne’s Battle Skill even though it, itself, is the one applying solidification. This is also the case for her combo skill.
 Yvonne’s other talent, Barrage of Technology, is a key piece of her rotation. After unlocking it, it allows her to immediately launch a Final Strike after applying Solidification with her Battle Skill - something which is essential for satisfying the trigger requirement of her Combo Skill. At max rank, this talent also boosts the damage of said Final Strike as well. It’s no exaggeration to say that playing Yvonne without this talent feels clunky, so unlock it as soon as you can.

sections.heading: Ultimate
sections.text:
Yvonne’s Ultimate is responsible for the majority of her damage, costs 220 energy to activate, and is what you’ll be structuring your entire team's playstyle plus rotations around. Using it causes Yvonne to become the controlled operator and enter a special stance for 7 seconds. During this time, her basic attacks are enhanced to become rapid fire, with each successful shot granting her a stacking buff up to 10 times that boosts Crit Rate for each stack.
 At max stacks, this buff grants 30% Crit Rate as well as an additional bonus of 60% Crit DMG, which only activates at 10 stacks. The ultimate duration itself is broken up into 3 sections, an initial wind-up period which fires ~10 bullets, a quick pause, then a crouch where Yvonne will unload a constant stream of ~60-70 bullets, after that and when the timer is close to expiring she’ll fire a finishing shot dealing a large burst of damage, and if the enemy is solidified will consume it to deal even more damage.
 Timing when to use this Ultimate is everything, as unlike many other characters, landing all its damage isn’t guaranteed. Any time you need to take dodging, or being interrupted by enemies will result in a loss of damage. Because of this, it’s usually optimal to pair it with enemy Stagger or moments of free-fire to ensure it all lands. The other thing to consider when it comes to timing is ensuring all team buffs/debuffs are active before use, and that the enemy will be Solidified during the final shot to maximize damage.
 Note: Despite stating the Ultimate lasts 7 seconds, it actually lasts longer when factoring in wind-up time, crouching, and final shot animations.
 Tip: Because Yvonne’s Ultimate grants 30% Crit Rate, she therefore has a soft cap of 70% from gear/weapons. You don’t want to go over; otherwise, you’ll be wasting stats during her most important damage window.

sections.heading: Battle Skill
sections.text:
Yvonne’s Battle Skill is the next piece of the puzzle, which makes up the majority of her energy generation. Using it lobs a bomb at your target (which can miss) that explodes, dealing Cryo Damage, some Stagger, but most importantly, consumes Cryo or Nature infliction to forcibly apply Solidification.
 This force Solidification deals no damage of its own, but Yvonne will deal additional Battle Skill damage based on the number of Inflictions consumed (a multiplier that is added to the base multiplier). Also, depending on the amount of Inflictions you consume when this Solidification is applied, Yvonne will also generate additional energy - with 10 being the baseline and an additional 30 being added for every Infliction consumed, meaning a Battle Skill that consumes 4 will grant 130 bonus energy. Balancing how many Inflictions to apply before using this ability is key to mastering Yvonne’s rotations. We’ll be covering that in the energy section below.
 Note: Using this Battle Skill against enemies with no Inflictions will not trigger Solidification and therefore grant no bonus energy. In addition to the listed bonus energy, this ability grants the usual 6.5 global energy to the whole team.

sections.heading: Combo
sections.text:
Last but not least, the final piece of the puzzle is Yvonne’s combo skill, which simply requires the controlled operator (which should be Yvonne) to land a Final Strike on a solidified enemy. When playing Yvonne properly, this is beyond easy to achieve by simply Solidifying with her Battle Skill and taking advantage of her Barrage of Technology talent to launch an instant Final Strike.
 On use, the Combo grants 20 energy and deploys a robot in a target area with an AoE radius around it. This robot lasts 3 seconds and pulses Cryo damage within its radius 4 times before finally exploding, dealing a larger amount of Cryo damage, some Stagger, and forcibly applying Solidification (counts as a 1 Infliction application). This ability is mostly useful for the energy it generates and the delayed Solidification it provides.
 In order to land the final strike of Yvonne’s Ultimate, the enemy needs to be Solidified at the end of its long duration, something that’s not easy to align if it wasn’t for this Combo Skill. Launching the combo right before using Yvonne’s Ultimate will time the Solidification just right so that it applies right before the majority of the damage of the Ultimate and lasts long enough for the Final Strike to explode it. Because of this, it should always be the last action you launch before entering her Ultimate.

 The usual magic number for non-Ultimate Gain Yvonne rotations ranges between 4 to 5 Inflictions, depending on the number of how many of her own Battle Skills are used, owing to its bonus energy on Solidification. This means she can work either with 4 Inflictions, 3 Battle Skills and 2 Combo Skills, or 5 Inflictions, 2 Battle and 2 Combo Skills.

sections.heading: Gameplay
sections.text:
Once you have your energy mapped out and your team set-up Yvonne isn’t too complicated to play, but it will depend on all the information covered in the energy section above and what you decided to go with.
 For simplicity's sake, we’ll be breaking down how to play Yvonne without energy, but it will change a little if you decide to use some. Yvonne’s no-energy rotations are usually split up into two halves, one half for each battle/combo skill.
 Open the fight by applying 1 or 2 Cryo/Nature Infliction, then Solidify them with Yvonne’s battle skill. Going for lower stack sizes early on in the fight is usually optimal to get combo skills on cooldown faster.

 Next perform an instant Final Strike to trigger Yvonne’s combo skill and recover some SP. If you’re playing a character capable of triggering Shatter with their combo skill, like Gil or Estella, only use it after landing Yvonne’s Final Strike.

 After that, deploy Yvonne’s combo skill. This marks the end of the first half.

 Start the second half in the exact same way as the first, but build 3 or 4 Cryo stacks to bring your total between both rotations to 5 (how many you need depends on how many you started with)

 Use the same Battle Skill into Combo Skill sequence, but this time, after that, use all available team cooldowns (shorter duration buffs/debuffs can be saved for mid-way through Yvonne’s Ultimate) and move straight into Yvonne’s Ultimate and fully channel it for as long as possible. After this, rinse and repeat.

 Yvonne's Signature Handcannon and the best weapon choice across the board, thanks to its outstanding weapon passives featuring her main stat Intellect, Crit Rate (which, for Yvonne, is one of her best stats) and a good chunk of Cryo DMG%. This Handcannon's Weapon Effect is what truly pushes it ahead of the competition, as the amount of Cryo DMG% it grants, along with its very easy trigger requirement and absurdly long 30s buff duration, makes it notably stronger than alternatives with similar effects. The one catch with this weapon is that Yvonne must build enough Crit Rate to consistently maintain all 3 stacks of its buff, something which requires 50% Crit Rate on average, as her Combo hits 5 times and her Battle Skill hits once, but building more than that can be a good idea to be safe. sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
Cryo

 Tangtang Cryo

 Tangtang is an amazing Sub-DPS for Yvonne thanks to her strong damage potential and Arts Susceptibility debuff.

 Since Yvonne cannot apply any Cryo Inflictions by herself, Tangtang is the most reliable for this as her application is instant and hard to miss, can be used to interrupt enemy attack patterns.

 Tangtang also has occasionally cheaper Cryo Inflictions through SP Return after consuming Whirlpools

 Tangtang's Ultimate is phenomenal for keeping enemies inside Yvonne's Combo Skill as she suffers massive damage loss if enemies are not hit by her Combo Skill's Solidification.

 Cryo

 Xaihi Cryo

 Xaihi is a mainstay in most Cryo teams thanks to her Battle Skill and Ultimate's incredible Cryo and Nature Amp; Yvonne is no exception to this.

 In addition to superb buffing, Xaihi also provides semi-free Cryo Infliction via her Combo Skill, which contributes to the Inflictions Yvonne needs in order to access her Ultimate.

 The combination of both of these usually lands Xaihi on most Yvonne teams, regardless of whether they're Nature or Cryo focused.

 Nature

 Gilberta Nature

 Gilberta is one of Yvonne's premier support choices thanks to her ability to apply a short but potent Susceptibility debuff to enemies, which, when aligned correctly with Yvonne's Ultimate, leads to much higher bursts.

 As a Solidification expert, Yvonne also easily triggers and synergizes with Gil's Combo Skill, which requires Reactions and forcibly Lifts enemies on use. Using Gil's Combo directly after Yvonne's Battle Skill allows her to trigger Shatter before Yvonne re-solidifies the enemy with her own combo, resulting in free extra damage.

 The other reasons to bring Gil to Yvonne's team are her great grouping, which boosts AoE potential, and her Nature Infliction, which, when played and built around correctly, serves as great fuel for Yvonne's Battle Skills.

 Cryo

 Alesh Cryo

 Alesh is an excellent vanguard that excels in SP recovery and can supply Cryo Inflictions via his Ultimate, having an especially good synergy with Yvonne owing to her constant Solidifications, which can fuel his Ultimate Energy.

 He can either run with Frontiers or as a pure Ultimate Energy supportive pick, offering strong buffs via his Rare Fin (if at P3) and being able to use weapons like Thermite Cutter that provide significant damage gains to Yvonne.

 He does demand characters that can Shatter Solidifications to trigger his Combo Skill (such as Gilberta or Estella), but in such teams, he performs incredibly well.

 Electric

 Perlica Electric

 Perlica is a Skill Point neutral, strong amplifier support for any Arts DMG team

 Her Combo Skill forcibly applies Electrification to increase enemies' Arts DMG Taken, and she can stack Arts Intensity to improve this debuff. With P4 and baseline gears, she increases enemies' Arts DMG Taken by ~25%

 As an Arts Unit Operator, Perlica has access to Stanza of Memorials which can increase teammates' ATK by a significant amount after using her Ultimate

 Nature

 Fluorite Nature

 Fluorite is one of Yvonne's stronger Infliction-based partners, able to act as her team's main applier by using her Battle Skill to apply Nature Infliction, which, alongside her Combo Skill plus Ultimate and a character like Gilberta, easily allows the team to reach 3-4 Nature Infliction fast.

 Lacks the SP return of Estella, Snowshine on battle skill, but more than makes up for it with her Combo and Ultimate.

 Cryo

 Snowshine Cryo

 Snowshine is a Cryo Infliction applier who can serve as an alternative to Last Rite or Estella.

 Snowshine will do less damage than both of them, is a little harder to consistently apply Cryo Infliction with, due to it being attatched to her Battle Skills retaliation, but the trade-off is that Snowshine can run supportive sets like Xiranite or LYNX, has great team-wide sustain, has a crowd control based Ultimate, Solidification applied by Ultimate gives bursts of higher Crit DMG for Yvonne, and she can become even more SP efficient at P5 if you can get it.

 Cryo

 Estella Cryo

 Estella is yet another Cryo Infliction applier who works with Yvonne, but who sets herself apart by trading a little of the SP efficiency of Last Rite and Snow Shine (has 85 SP cost Cryo instead of 70) for the ability to deal significantly more damage in the team.

 What gives Estella the edge in damage over other Cryo Infliction appliers is her Combo Skill, which, when used after Yvonne's Battle Skill, can trigger huge Shatters at very little opportunity cost (a little Crit DMG uptime in the time before Yvonne's combo explodes).

 In addition to this, thanks again to her Combo Skill and also her Ultimate Estella also outputs above-average Stagger compared to alternatives, something which can be boosted further with an Arts Intensity build, a build that will also boost Shatter damage further.

 Cryo

 Last Rite Cryo

 Last Rite and her spammable Battle Skill are currently one of the go-to ways to apply Infliction in Yvonne teams, thanks to its discounted SP cost coming in at 70 instead of the usual 100.

 With that said, the synergy between the two isn't actually that strong, as Yvonne should be consuming all the team's Cryo Inflcition, meaning Last Rite won't have any for her Combo Skill, which more or less locks her out of using her Ultimate in all but the longest fights. It's not all doom and gloom though.

 Last Rite's Basic Attacks, Battle Skills and occasional non-consuming Combo Skills still add up to an OK amount of damage, so she won't be completely useless outside her inflictions.

 With all that said, running Last Rite with Yvonne can feel wasteful as Last Rite is capable of achieving similar or, in some cases, even better performance than Yvonne in her own dedicated hypercarry teams.

 Review

 Kit Intro
 Yvonne is a 6-star, Cryo, Handcannon damage dealer, completely centered around building and consuming Cryo or Nature Infliction stacks with her Battle Skill in order to access her Ultimate, which is responsible for most of her damage.
 Similar to other hyper carries like Laevatain or Last Rite, Yvonne features an incredibly powerful but expensive Ultimate that can only be efficiently accessed by playing into her signature mechanic of Solidification. Yvonne’s core gameplay loop is building Nature or Cryo Infliction on enemies, then forcibly consuming them with her Battle Skill to generate energy based on the amount of the stacks, while also forcibly applying Solidification in the process. Doing this also immediately triggers her combo skill, which grants yet more energy and applies Solidification again after a short delay, which is a perfect segway into her Ultimate, which causes her to fire a stream of bullets over 7-8 seconds, followed by a Solidification-consuming final shot - when timed correctly, it will consume the Solidification applied by the combo.
 In well-structured teams, Yvonne’s rotations flow nicely, but there can be some pitfalls if you’re not careful. Yvonne can easily mix Nature and Cryo units and Inflictions, but wants to isolate their Infliction application to one type per Battle Skill to avoid Natural Arts reactions. Any reaction you trigger outside of Yvonne’s Battle Skill is wasted energy that Yvonne could have put toward her next Ultimate. Because of this, it’s important to manage when you’re using each character's abilities to ensure you only apply either Cryo or Nature at one time. An easy solution is to just play either Nature or Cryo, but doing so may limit you from playing the most powerful unit combinations.
 The other thing to consider when playing Yvonne is that her Ultimate requires a significant amount of in-game time to fully execute, something that is easier said than done against boss enemies immune to Solidification's controlling effect. Against these enemies, you’ll either need to wait for Stagger or time it perfectly, or else you’ll risk losing firing time and thus a lot of potential damage. Yvonne’s combo skill suffers a similar fate, being a deployable object that pulses damage over a short period, only to then explode. Throw it at the wrong time, or in the wrong position, and enemies can easily walk straight out of it, causing lost damage and, more importantly, a loss of potential Solidification application, which, when considering Yvonne’s Ultimate finishing effect, can also reduce potential damage a lot.
 All up, Yvonne is a quirky hyper-carry character who relies on Inflictions to function, but can’t apply them herself, instead relying on teammates and strong team building to enable her. She requires planning in and out of combat to be effective, but can deliver satisfying payoffs when everything lines up just right.
 Passives
 Before getting into the meat of Yvonne’s kit, it’s important to understand her passives, one of which is vital to her damage scaling and the other of which is a key part of her rotations.
 Her first talent, Freezing Point, grants her up to 20 Crit DMG% when attacking enemies with Cryo Infliction and double that (40%) when attacking Solidified enemies. Crit DMG% is an incredibly rare stat in Endfield, and having access to so much of it here and from her Ultimate makes Crit Rate one of Yvonne’s best stats. Yvonne will have Solidification up for most of her most impactful damage-dealing moments just by executing a standard rotation, but the fact that Cryo teams can maintain Cryo Infliction the rest of the time is one edge that Infliction type has over Nature-themed teams for Yvonne.
 Note: The bonus Crit DMG% from this talent applies to the damage dealt by Yvonne’s Battle Skill even though it, itself, is the one applying solidification. This is also the case for her combo skill.
 Yvonne’s other talent, Barrage of Technology, is a key piece of her rotation. After unlocking it, it allows her to immediately launch a Final Strike after applying Solidification with her Battle Skill - something which is essential for satisfying the trigger requirement of her Combo Skill. At max rank, this talent also boosts the damage of said Final Strike as well. It’s no exaggeration to say that playing Yvonne without this talent feels clunky, so unlock it as soon as you can.
 Ultimate
 Yvonne’s Ultimate is responsible for the majority of her damage, costs 220 energy to activate, and is what you’ll be structuring your entire team's playstyle plus rotations around. Using it causes Yvonne to become the controlled operator and enter a special stance for 7 seconds. During this time, her basic attacks are enhanced to become rapid fire, with each successful shot granting her a stacking buff up to 10 times that boosts Crit Rate for each stack.
 At max stacks, this buff grants 30% Crit Rate as well as an additional bonus of 60% Crit DMG, which only activates at 10 stacks. The ultimate duration itself is broken up into 3 sections, an initial wind-up period which fires ~10 bullets, a quick pause, then a crouch where Yvonne will unload a constant stream of ~60-70 bullets, after that and when the timer is close to expiring she’ll fire a finishing shot dealing a large burst of damage, and if the enemy is solidified will consume it to deal even more damage.
 Timing when to use this Ultimate is everything, as unlike many other characters, landing all its damage isn’t guaranteed. Any time you need to take dodging, or being interrupted by enemies will result in a loss of damage. Because of this, it’s usually optimal to pair it with enemy Stagger or moments of free-fire to ensure it all lands. The other thing to consider when it comes to timing is ensuring all team buffs/debuffs are active before use, and that the enemy will be Solidified during the final shot to maximize damage.
 Note: Despite stating the Ultimate lasts 7 seconds, it actually lasts longer when factoring in wind-up time, crouching, and final shot animations.
 Tip: Because Yvonne’s Ultimate grants 30% Crit Rate, she therefore has a soft cap of 70% from gear/weapons. You don’t want to go over; otherwise, you’ll be wasting stats during her most important damage window.
 Battle Skill
 Yvonne’s Battle Skill is the next piece of the puzzle, which makes up the majority of her energy generation. Using it lobs a bomb at your target (which can miss) that explodes, dealing Cryo Damage, some Stagger, but most importantly, consumes Cryo or Nature infliction to forcibly apply Solidification.
 This force Solidification deals no damage of its own, but Yvonne will deal additional Battle Skill damage based on the number of Inflictions consumed (a multiplier that is added to the base multiplier). Also, depending on the amount of Inflictions you consume when this Solidification is applied, Yvonne will also generate additional energy - with 10 being the baseline and an additional 30 being added for every Infliction consumed, meaning a Battle Skill that consumes 4 will grant 130 bonus energy. Balancing how many Inflictions to apply before using this ability is key to mastering Yvonne’s rotations. We’ll be covering that in the energy section below.
 Note: Using this Battle Skill against enemies with no Inflictions will not trigger Solidification and therefore grant no bonus energy. In addition to the listed bonus energy, this ability grants the usual 6.5 global energy to the whole team.
 Combo
 Last but not least, the final piece of the puzzle is Yvonne’s combo skill, which simply requires the controlled operator (which should be Yvonne) to land a Final Strike on a solidified enemy. When playing Yvonne properly, this is beyond easy to achieve by simply Solidifying with her Battle Skill and taking advantage of her Barrage of Technology talent to launch an instant Final Strike.
 On use, the Combo grants 20 energy and deploys a robot in a target area with an AoE radius around it. This robot lasts 3 seconds and pulses Cryo damage within its radius 4 times before finally exploding, dealing a larger amount of Cryo damage, some Stagger, and forcibly applying Solidification (counts as a 1 Infliction application). This ability is mostly useful for the energy it generates and the delayed Solidification it provides.
 In order to land the final strike of Yvonne’s Ultimate, the enemy needs to be Solidified at the end of its long duration, something that’s not easy to align if it wasn’t for this Combo Skill. Launching the combo right before using Yvonne’s Ultimate will time the Solidification just right so that it applies right before the majority of the damage of the Ultimate and lasts long enough for the Final Strike to explode it. Because of this, it should always be the last action you launch before entering her Ultimate.

Our target is 220 energy - a figure which can be reached in a myriad of different ways, with or without the Ultimate Gain stat, both of which are viable. To start with, let's cover non-Ultimate Gain.

 Gameplay
 Once you have your energy mapped out and your team set-up Yvonne isn’t too complicated to play, but it will depend on all the information covered in the energy section above and what you decided to go with.
 For simplicity's sake, we’ll be breaking down how to play Yvonne without energy, but it will change a little if you decide to use some. Yvonne’s no-energy rotations are usually split up into two halves, one half for each battle/combo skill.
 Open the fight by applying 1 or 2 Cryo/Nature Infliction, then Solidify them with Yvonne’s battle skill. Going for lower stack sizes early on in the fight is usually optimal to get combo skills on cooldown faster.

 Next perform an instant Final Strike to trigger Yvonne’s combo skill and recover some SP. If you’re playing a character capable of triggering Shatter with their combo skill, like Gil or Estella, only use it after landing Yvonne’s Final Strike.

 After that, deploy Yvonne’s combo skill. This marks the end of the first half.

 Start the second half in the exact same way as the first, but build 3 or 4 Cryo stacks to bring your total between both rotations to 5 (how many you need depends on how many you started with)

 Use the same Battle Skill into Combo Skill sequence, but this time, after that, use all available team cooldowns (shorter duration buffs/debuffs can be saved for mid-way through Yvonne’s Ultimate) and move straight into Yvonne’s Ultimate and fully channel it for as long as possible. After this, rinse and repeat.

 As a Solidification expert, Yvonne also easily triggers and synergizes with Gil's Combo Skill, which requires Reactions and forcibly Lifts enemies on use. Using Gil's Combo directly after Yvonne's Battle Skill allows her to trigger Shatter before Yvonne re-solidifies the enemy with her own combo, resulting in free extra damage.

 The other reasons to bring Gil to Yvonne's team are her great grouping, which boosts AoE potential, and her Nature Infliction, which, when played and built around correctly, serves as great fuel for Yvonne's Battle Skills.

 Cryo

 Alesh Cryo

 Alesh is an excellent vanguard that excels in SP recovery and can supply Cryo Inflictions via his Ultimate, having an especially good synergy with Yvonne owing to her constant Solidifications, which can fuel his Ultimate Energy.

 He can either run with Frontiers or as a pure Ultimate Energy supportive pick, offering strong buffs via his Rare Fin (if at P3) and being able to use weapons like Thermite Cutter that provide significant damage gains to Yvonne.

 He does demand characters that can Shatter Solidifications to trigger his Combo Skill (such as Gilberta or Estella), but in such teams, he performs incredibly well.

 Perlica Electric

 Perlica is a Skill Point neutral, strong amplifier support for any Arts DMG team

 Her Combo Skill forcibly applies Electrification to increase enemies' Arts DMG Taken, and she can stack Arts Intensity to improve this debuff. With P4 and baseline gears, she increases enemies' Arts DMG Taken by ~25%

 As an Arts Unit Operator, Perlica has access to Stanza of Memorials which can increase teammates' ATK by a significant amount after using her Ultimate

 Nature

 Fluorite Nature

 Fluorite is one of Yvonne's stronger Infliction-based partners, able to act as her team's main applier by using her Battle Skill to apply Nature Infliction, which, alongside her Combo Skill plus Ultimate and a character like Gilberta, easily allows the team to reach 3-4 Nature Infliction fast.

 Lacks the SP return of Estella, Snowshine on battle skill, but more than makes up for it with her Combo and Ultimate.

 Cryo

 Snowshine Cryo

 Snowshine is a Cryo Infliction applier who can serve as an alternative to Last Rite or Estella.

 Snowshine will do less damage than both of them, is a little harder to consistently apply Cryo Infliction with, due to it being attatched to her Battle Skills retaliation, but the trade-off is that Snowshine can run supportive sets like Xiranite or LYNX, has great team-wide sustain, has a crowd control based Ultimate, Solidification applied by Ultimate gives bursts of higher Crit DMG for Yvonne, and she can become even more SP efficient at P5 if you can get it.

 Cryo

 Estella Cryo

 Estella is yet another Cryo Infliction applier who works with Yvonne, but who sets herself apart by trading a little of the SP efficiency of Last Rite and Snow Shine (has 85 SP cost Cryo instead of 70) for the ability to deal significantly more damage in the team.

 What gives Estella the edge in damage over other Cryo Infliction appliers is her Combo Skill, which, when used after Yvonne's Battle Skill, can trigger huge Shatters at very little opportunity cost (a little Crit DMG uptime in the time before Yvonne's combo explodes).

 In addition to this, thanks again to her Combo Skill and also her Ultimate Estella also outputs above-average Stagger compared to alternatives, something which can be boosted further with an Arts Intensity build, a build that will also boost Shatter damage further.

 Cryo

 Last Rite Cryo

 Last Rite and her spammable Battle Skill are currently one of the go-to ways to apply Infliction in Yvonne teams, thanks to its discounted SP cost coming in at 70 instead of the usual 100.

 With that said, the synergy between the two isn't actually that strong, as Yvonne should be consuming all the team's Cryo Inflcition, meaning Last Rite won't have any for her Combo Skill, which more or less locks her out of using her Ultimate in all but the longest fights. It's not all doom and gloom though.

 Last Rite's Basic Attacks, Battle Skills and occasional non-consuming Combo Skills still add up to an OK amount of damage, so she won't be completely useless outside her inflictions.

 With all that said, running Last Rite with Yvonne can feel wasteful as Last Rite is capable of achieving similar or, in some cases, even better performance than Yvonne in her own dedicated hypercarry teams.
